title: A Tsang-range high-moment bound for $\operatorname{Im}\log L(\tfrac12+it,χ)$ under GRH
summary: Conditional on the Generalized Riemann Hypothesis for $L(s,χ)$, we prove the Selberg--Tsang high-moment bound for $X_χ(t) = \operatorname{Im}\log L(\tfrac12+it,χ)$ at fixed squarefree odd conductor $q \ge 3$ and primitive non-principal character $χ$. Writing $L_T = \log\log(qT)$: for every $K > 0$ there exist constants $C_K$ and $T_0$ such that $\frac{1}{T}\int_T^{2T} |X_χ(t)|^{2k}\,dt \le (C_K\,k\,L_T)^k$ for all $T \ge T_0$ and every integer $1 \le k \le K L_T$. The proof ports Selberg's pointwise approximate formula for $S(t)$ to $L(s,χ)$ at fixed conductor under GRH, splits it into three…
